name: Kisan Copper Oxychloride 50% WP (Fungicide)
description: Broad-spectrum contact fungicide and bactericide. Highly effective against early & late blight, downy mildew, and leaf spots.
dosage: 2.5g to 3g per liter of water as foliar spray.

name: Bio-Neem Supreme (Cold Pressed 10,000 PPM)
description: 100% natural organic pesticide and repellent. Controls leaf miners, whiteflies, aphids, and inhibits fungal spore germination.
dosage: 3ml to 5ml per liter of water. Spray during evening hours.

name: Mancozeb 75% WP Contact Fungicide
description: Protective contact fungicide with broad spectrum activity. Ideal for rusts, blights, and anthracnose prevention.

name: NPK 19:19:19 100% Water Soluble Fertilizer
description: Balanced macro-nutrients formula for vegetative growth, strong stem, and healthy blooming. Rapid leaf absorption.
dosage: 5g per liter of water for foliar spray, or 3-5kg per acre via drip.

name: Chelated Zinc (Zn-EDTA 12%)
description: Fast-acting chelated zinc micronutrient. Solves Khaira disease in paddy, interveinal chlorosis, and stunted leaf formation.

name: Hexaconazole 5% SC Systemic Fungicide
description: Potent systemic triazole fungicide. Eradicates powdery mildew, sheath blight, and rusts rapidly inside plant tissues.

name: Organic Vermicompost Premium Bio-Gold
description: Earthworm cast compost enriched with beneficial soil microbes, nitrogen, and humus. Restores soil biology.

name: Sulphur 80% WDG (Fungicide & Micronutrient)
description: Dual action: controls powdery mildew and mites while supplying essential sulfur for oil content and chlorophyll synthesis.

name: Tricyclazole 75% WP (Rice Blast Specialist)
description: Specialized systemic fungicide engineered for rapid cure and prevention of Rice Blast (Leaf Blast, Neck Blast, Node Blast) and Sheath Rot in paddy.
dosage: 0.6g per liter of water (120g in 200L water per acre).

name: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP
description: Dual-action systemic and contact fungicide. Proven gold-standard treatment for Late Blight in Potato/Tomato and Downy Mildew in Grapes & Cucurbits.

name: Streptocycline + Tetracycline Agricultural Bactericide
description: Potent agricultural bactericide for bacterial leaf blight, bacterial canker, black rot, and bacterial wilt.
dosage: 0.05g to 0.1g per liter (6g sachet in 60-120 Liters of water, combined with Copper Oxychloride).

name: Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC
description: Broad-spectrum strobilurin and triazole fungicide with preventative, curative, and translaminar properties against anthracnose, fruit rot, blights, and rusts.
dosage: 1ml per liter of water (200ml per acre).

name: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL (Systemic Insecticide)
description: Systemic neonicotinoid insecticide. Controls sucking pests (Whiteflies, Jassids, Aphids, Thrips) that transmit viral diseases like Leaf Curl Virus.
dosage: 0.5ml per liter of water (100ml per acre).

name: Disodium Octaborate Tetrahydrate (Boron 20%)
description: High purity foliar boron micronutrient. Prevents flower and fruit drop, fruit cracking, internal rot, and enhances pollen fertility.

name: Potassium Sulphate (0:0:50 Sulphate of Potash - SOP)
description: 100% water-soluble chloride-free potassium and sulfur fertilizer. Improves grain filling, fruit size, sweetness, disease resistance, and prevents leaf edge scorching.
dosage: 5g to 7g per liter of water (1kg in 150-200L per acre).

name: Bio-Trichoderma Viride (1% WP Bio-Fungicide)
description: Natural beneficial antagonistic fungal bio-control agent. Eradicates soil-borne fungal pathogens causing Fusarium Wilt, Root Rot, Collar Rot, and Damping Off.
dosage: Seed treatment: 10g/kg seed. Soil drenching: 5g per liter. Soil application: 2kg mixed with 100kg FYM/Vermicompost per acre.
